snippet.title: No Retreat, No Surrender | The First Descendant Season 3 Episode 2: Assemble
snippet.description:
“No Retreat, No Surrender”
The turning point leading to the final battle against Karel -
Look forward to Season 3 Episode 2 “Assemble,” coming on November 6!

🎮 PLAY FREE NOW: https://tfd.nexon.com/

The First Descendant is a free-to-play, third-person co-op action RPG shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Featuring a diverse roster of unique characters, it offers both solo play and up to 8-player co-op where you can take on strategic boss battles. Experience the thrill of intense gunplay combined with the excitement of looting.
